interactions_source_event_npc_unique.name: interactions_source_event_npc_unique
interactions_source_event_npc_unique.where: "interactions"."source_provider" is not null and "interactions"."source_message_id" is not null

interaction_response_claim_shape.name: interaction_response_claim_shape
interaction_response_claim_shape.value:
("interactions"."response_claim_id" is null and "interactions"."response_claimed_at" is null
        and "interactions"."response_dispatched_at" is null and "interactions"."response_prompt_version" is null
        and "interactions"."response_generation_outcome" is null)
      or ("interactions"."response_claim_id" is not null and "interactions"."response_claimed_at" is not null
        and "interactions"."response_prompt_version" is not null and length("interactions"."response_prompt_version") > 0
        and "interactions"."response_generation_outcome" is not null
        and "interactions"."response_generation_outcome" in ('claimed','dispatched','responded','failed','uncertain')
        and ("interactions"."response_generation_outcome" not in ('dispatched','responded','uncertain')
          or "interactions"."response_dispatched_at" is not null))

interaction_source_provider_message.name: interaction_source_provider_message
interaction_source_provider_message.value: "interactions"."source_provider" is null or ("interactions"."source_message_id" is not null and length("interactions"."source_message_id") > 0 and length("interactions"."source_provider") > 0)

llm_usage_lifecycle.name: llm_usage_lifecycle
llm_usage_lifecycle.value: ("llm_usage"."status" = 'reserved' and "llm_usage"."settled_at" is null and "llm_usage"."charged_micros" = "llm_usage"."reserved_micros") or ("llm_usage"."status" <> 'reserved' and "llm_usage"."settled_at" is not null)

llm_usage_tokens.name: llm_usage_tokens
llm_usage_tokens.value: ("llm_usage"."input_tokens" is null and "llm_usage"."output_tokens" is null and "llm_usage"."total_tokens" is null) or ("llm_usage"."input_tokens" is not null and "llm_usage"."output_tokens" is not null and "llm_usage"."total_tokens" is not null and "llm_usage"."input_tokens" >= 0 and "llm_usage"."output_tokens" >= 0 and "llm_usage"."total_tokens" = "llm_usage"."input_tokens" + "llm_usage"."output_tokens")

llm_usage_diagnostics.name: llm_usage_diagnostics
llm_usage_diagnostics.value: "llm_usage"."retries" between 0 and 2 and ("llm_usage"."latency_ms" is null or "llm_usage"."latency_ms" >= 0)
